verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance sells registered-agent service at a published $99/year rate with multi-year purchase options. It says customers can 'instantly access state forms pre-filled with our registered agent address,' which points to near-immediate access to the address a formation or change filing needs. However, the evidence never explicitly documents online self-serve checkout, never states that the exact agent name is provided, and never commits to same-day delivery of these details. Missing for 10: documented online checkout flow, explicit provision of the exact agent name, an explicit same-day/instant guarantee for the agent details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
